inputs.P: Frozen fixed raw four-member probability matrix, declared stable FP64 convention
inputs.y: True VALID label used explicitly for this retrospective oracle only
inputs.native_error_filter: Frozen native FP32 prediction contract; arithmetic discrepancies separate

exact_interpretation.positive: Strictly correctable by some allowed mixture
exact_interpretation.zero: Weak y maximizer only; smallest-class decoder needs tie-resolution feasibility

tie_rule: Against c<y strict positive margin; against c>y nonnegative margin. Closed-floor and finite-softmax boundary-only cases are distinct.
certificates: Feasible primal w gives lower margin bound; competitor-simplex lambda gives dual upper bound, with arithmetic/residual correction.
near_zero_or_failed_certificate: UNRESOLVED; never automatically exact tie or impossibility
member_correctness_union: Neither necessary nor sufficient under positive floor; analytic counterexamples in REPORT.md
descriptive_only_outputs: exact decoder tie category when certified
usefulness: Pointwise headroom/ceiling of the fixed restricted probability mixture family only
